title: Tree diagram template
subject: Mathematics
unit: Spring 2: Revision cycle 2: Geometry, vectors, statistics, calculus
source: Seeded from mathematics/y11 lesson 87 (Tree diagram template (printable, in the pupil PDF))
intro: Lesson 87: Probability: tree diagrams and conditional probability. To understand how to use tree diagrams for independent and dependent events

blocks.text: Write each outcome at the end of a branch and its probability on the branch. Multiply along the branches; add the end results that you need.

questions.q: A spinner gives 1 with probability 0.4. It is spun twice. P(both 1s)?
A box has 4 dates and 6 figs. Two are taken without replacement. P(both figs)?

A bag has 7 green and 3 yellow beads. Two are taken without replacement. (a) Complete the tree diagram [2] (b) P(both yellow) [2] (c) P(same colour) [3] (d) P(at least one green) [2] (e) Given that the first is green, P(the second is yellow) [3]
questions.a: (a) first 7/10, 3/10; second 6/9, 3/9 after green and 7/9, 2/9 after yellow (b) 1/15 (c) 8/15 (d) 14/15 (e) 1/3

questions.q: A bag has n red and 4 blue balls. Two are taken without replacement and P(both blue) = 1/11. Find n.

questions.a: No: after a red is taken it is 4/7; after a blue it is 5/7.
